scope: Independent semantic assessment of complete source and exact evidence; no keyword oracle.
representation: Equivalent faithful wording and links allowed; authored controls are examples, not live gold.

checks.assessment: For each deadline, compare stated clock, timezone and timeliness basis to c/q/r. Each absent dimension must be explicitly unknown; no inferred timestamp or receipt rule. Preserve known dimensions and source-established inapplicability. Distinguish not stated from stated-but-ambiguous and source-established not applicable; preserve known5p.m./Eastern/receipt without sticky unknowns or offset conversion.

Check affected rule and historical filing identities independently. Transition explicitly targets rule; links preserve rule identity and filing context, with separately anchored filing/effective dates. A context/entity d link does not establish normative prerequisites; require explicit assertion and source basis.

Inspect every proposition in the broad span. Independently lossy actor, phase, date, clock, jurisdiction, component, role and transition facts need independently preserved units; necessary qualifications remain attached.

Review actual action, actor, purpose and qualifications. Ambiguous force remains m5 with reason; explicit modal wording is assessed in context. Disagreement with a reference does not alone prove error.
Check background and unresolved functions alongside participation and proposed/deleted rule content. All evidence IDs cited and END do not prove discovery completeness.

negative_controls.silently_missing_deadline_dimensions: Semantically deficient: date-only deadline silently loses all three unknown dimensions; host still accepts.
negative_controls.historical_filing_replaces_affected_rule: Semantically deficient: transition changes the affected object despite separate identities and valid links.
negative_controls.independently_lossy_facts_bundled: Atomicity defect: city and province facts bundled; facts retained but independently lossy boundaries gone.
negative_controls.unsupported_force_certainty: Semantically deficient: ambiguous bare directive forced mandatory without evidence.
negative_controls.background_dropped_but_all_spans_still_c: Completeness defect: background assertion lost while broad evidence spans remain covered.

reporting: Separate known omissions/contradictions, disputed interpretations and unassessable source gaps; attach exact evidence and concrete implications. Counts are bookkeeping, not accuracy denominators.
limitations: No structured nullable deadline slots or typed context/normative edges: c/r/s must preserve states and roles, independently reviewed. Generic Claude advice is not implementation approval; future normalization needs a separate reviewed contract.

revision_checks.assessment: Preserve unspecified actor/reason; independent arrival/request clock and timezone facts stay linked to their qualified dates.
Full overlong s/c/r controls reject at unchanged caps without mutation or clipping. Shorter semantically incomplete output needs independent rejection.
Reject borrowed deadline assertion independently against unrelated archive evidence despite valid shape. Fixture data never enters prompt; future model tests require disjoint facts.
